q: But because I could not always stay there, I hired people and ___.
options: had the house to look after
explanation: 'have+목적어+과거분사'는 목적어(the house)가 ~되게 하다는 뜻으로, house가 관리받는(수동) 대상이므로 과거분사 looked after가 쓰인다. 원문: "But because I could not always stay there, I hired people and had the house looked after."

q: Father said we should sleep comfortably and enjoy our food, so I ___ by experts and my meals prepared by a great chef.
explanation: 'have+목적어+과거분사' 구조로 bed가 전문가에 의해 '설계되는' 수동의 의미이므로 designed가 쓰이며, 뒤의 had my meals prepared와 병렬을 이룬다. 원문: "Father said we should sleep comfortably and enjoy our food, so I had my bed designed by experts and my meals prepared by a great chef."

q: He told us to spend like a rich man, so I bought ___ without worrying about money.
explanation: what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사(= the thing(s) that/which)로, 앞에 따로 선행사를 쓰지 않는다. 원문: "He told us to spend like a rich man, so I bought what I wanted without worrying about money."

q: But look at me now! I am ___.
explanation: '빈손인'이라는 뜻의 형용사는 하이픈으로 연결된 복합형용사 empty-handed로 쓴다. 원문: "But look at me now! I am empty-handed."
'Didn't+주어+동사 ~?' 형태의 부정 의문문에서 부정의 의미를 강조하기 위해 not을 분리하면 'Did+주어+not+동사 ~?'가 되므로 Did you not follow가 맞다. 원문: "Did you not follow our father's wisdom?"

q: "Tell me, brother, how did you ___ so rich?"
explanation: 조동사 did가 쓰인 의문문이므로 본동사는 동사원형이 와야 하며, get+형용사는 '~해지다'(상황의 변화)라는 뜻이다. 원문: "'Tell me, brother, how did you get so rich?'"

q: Puneet smiled and said, "My dear brother, I ___ our father's wisdom.
explanation: 빈도부사에 준하는 also는 일반동사 앞에 위치하며, 이야기 전체가 과거시제이므로 followed가 쓰인다. 원문: "Puneet smiled and said, 'My dear brother, I also followed our father's wisdom."

q: But I understood it a bit ___.
explanation: 동사 understood를 수식해야 하므로 부사 differently(다르게)가 쓰인다. 원문: "But I understood it a bit differently."

q: When he said 'build a house in every city,' I took it as ___ a place to stay all around the world.
explanation: 전치사 as의 목적어로는 동명사가 쓰여야 하므로 having이 온다(to stay는 a place를 꾸미는 to부정사의 형용사적 용법). 원문: "When he said 'build a house in every city,' I took it as having a place to stay all around the world."

q: So I ___ in every city and I stayed at their houses when I visited those cities.
explanation: '친구를 사귀다'라는 뜻의 관용 표현은 make friends로 friend를 복수형으로 쓴다. 원문: "So I made friends in every city and I stayed at their houses when I visited those cities."
